subject: NimbleRetail Renewal: Stability snapshot & exec escalation items
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NimbleRetail Renewal: Stability snapshot & exec escalation items

Team —

Quick read: NimbleRetail (renewal due 2027-06-30) is showing mixed signals on stability and adoption. We need a short executive decision on two asks before the QBR to avoid churn risk and to scope commitments for Dedicated capacity. I’ve attached a 4-slide stability snapshot and a draft terms memo.

Top-line summary
- Health: FOUR pilots in production; 60% weekly active usage on primary flows, but two recent latency incidents above SLO.
- Commercial: renewal target $420k ARR; procurement pushing for extended support credits and a firm SLA.
- Risk level: MODERATE -> HIGH (if we don’t provide an immediate mitigation plan + concessions).

Renewal risk register (candidate items for exec attention)
1) Unexplained latency spikes (2 incidents, 10–18% token-level tail latency increase) — Impact: customer warns of user complaints; Potential churn if unresolved. Mitigation: emergency triage by infra + temporary routing to a quantized variant. Owner: Rishi; Action by: 5/14.
2) Contract ask for multi-month credit tied to outage tolerance — Impact: revenue pressure if we concede >5% credit; Procurement will escalate. Mitigation: offer a one-time 3% credit + uptime remediation plan. Owner: Neha/Jonas; Decision needed by 5/16 (exec approval).
3) Security evidence request for SOC 2 logs for compliance audit — Impact: procurement hold on signature. Mitigation: provide curated log bundle and assign CISO liaison (Markus) for audit window. Owner: Laura; Action by: 5/18.

Requested executive actions
- Approve a capped commercial concession: authorize up to 3% one-time credit and a fast-track SLA review (yes/no).
- Greenlight an emergency infra task force (Rishi leads) to reduce tail latency before QBR.
- Confirm which exec will join the QBR (week of 5/24) — suggestion: Jonas for pricing, Laura for security, one engineering lead.

Next steps
- I’ve scheduled a 30-min prep slot on 5/14 10:00–10:30 PT (calendar invite sent) to align slides and decision points.
- Attachments: nimble_stability_deck.pdf (4 slides), draft_terms_v2.docx (commercial language).

Please review and flag any additional items. If you think we need to elevate to the COO for a larger concession, call it out in replies.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Lead — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbleRetail Renewal: Stability snapshot & exec escalation items

+1 to the ask list. A couple of tactical notes:

- Commercial concession: I support the 3% capped credit as a one-time goodwill gesture tied to a 90-day remediation milestone. If we offer anything larger, we should require a committed annual minimum.
- SOW/terms: I uploaded an updated SOW with explicit SLA windows and credit triggers to the DocuSign draft (link below). If legal signs off we can present at the QBR.
- QBR attendance: I can cover pricing and the commercial ask on the 5/24 prep call. Suggest Rishi present remediation timeline.

DocuSign (SOW draft): https://www.docusign.com/NR-2027-042-sow
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/NR-2027-042

On latency — Rishi, please prioritize a short RCA for the two incidents (root cause + short-term routing workarounds). If infra needs additional cores for a temporary burst, flag capacity and cost.

Jonas
VP, Sales

Thanks, Neha — good summary. Two quick additions from my side:

1) Security/Compliance: Procurement specifically asked for time-series retention of audit logs for 45 days in a curated bundle. I can produce the export by 5/18 but need confirmation from Markus (customer CISO) on scope. Recommend we provide the bundle and a short runbook for the audit.

2) Engineering asks: I attached a short CSV with the token-level latency regressions we observed (latency_regressions.csv). Rishi — can your team indicate whether the regressions align with model-serving hotspots or client-side batching? Need this before the 5/14 prep to ensure we can offer a remediation timeline.

Commercial note: If procurement pushes for >3% credit, escalate to me and Evelyn for approval conversation with revenue ops. For anything above 5% we should get C-level sign-off.

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbleRetail Renewal: Stability snapshot & exec escalation items

Neha / team —

Appreciate the clear summary and the quick turn on evidence. A few points from our side after internal review:

- We saw the same two latency events and they impacted a subset of high-conversion flows. We want assurance that the remediation will prevent recurrence during peak promo windows.
- Procurement will accept a 3% goodwill credit tied to a documented remediation plan and a post-remediation audit. If Redwood can commit to that window, procurement will move to sign.
- For SOC 2 logs: Markus will confirm the required fields and retention. We prefer the runbook be available before signature.

I’m copying procurement and Markus. We are flexible on QBR date; our priority is the remediation plan and the signed terms.

Amanda Chen
Head of Product Operations
NimbleRetail
